meanings.usage: 描述天气好或身体状况好
常与介词 in 搭配使用
与定冠词 the 连用，表示独一无二的事物
英式英语，美式英语为 airplane

examples.en: It is a fine day today.
There are some clouds in the sky.
Mr. Jones is with his family.
examples.zh: 琼斯先生和家人在一起。

examples.en: They are walking over the bridge.
Sally is looking at a big ship.
examples.zh: 莎莉正在看一艘大轮船。

examples.en: The ship is going under the bridge.
The aeroplane is flying over the river.

sentences.en: It is a fine day today.
There are some clouds in the sky,
Mr. Jones is with his family.
sentences.zh: 琼斯先生和家人在一起。

sentences.en: They are walking over the bridge.
There are some boats on the river.
Mr. Jones and his wife are looking at them.
sentences.zh: 琼斯先生和他的妻子正在看它们。

sentences.en: Sally is looking at a big ship.
The ship is going under the bridge.
Tim is looking at an aeroplane.
The aeroplane is flying over the river.

exercises.explain: sun · /sʌn/ · n. · 太阳。与定冠词 the 连用，表示独一无二的事物

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：好的；晴朗的
exercises.explain: fine · /faɪn/ · adj. · 好的；晴朗的。描述天气好或身体状况好
a fine day：表示晴朗、美好的天气（今天天气很好。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：It is a fine day _____
exercises.explain: It is a fine day today. — 今天天气很好。

source.en: It is a fine day today.

exercises.prompt: “表示正在发生的动作” 描述的是哪个语法点？
options: 形容词比较级和最高级
exercises.explain: 现在进行时：主语 + be + 动词-ing：描述说话时正在进行的动作

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
The ship is going under the bridge.
options: 他们的父亲每天送他们上学。
exercises.explain: The ship is going under the bridge. — 船正在从桥下穿过。

source.en: The ship is going under the bridge.

grammar.title: There be 句型
grammar.definition: 表示某地存在某物或某人
grammar.structure: There is/are + 名词 + 地点
grammar.usage: 表示客观存在的'有'，与 have/has 不同

examples.en: There are some clouds in the sky.
There are some boats on the river.

grammar.title: 现在进行时
grammar.usage: 描述说话时正在进行的动作

examples.en: They are walking over the bridge.
The ship is going under the bridge.

grammar.title: 方位介词 over 和 under
grammar.definition: over 表示在...上方（不接触），under 表示在...下方
grammar.usage: 描述物体之间的相对位置关系

examples.en: The ship is going under the bridge.
The aeroplane is flying over the river.

patterns.pattern: There is/are + 名词 + 介词短语

original.en: There are some clouds in the sky.

examples.en: There is a book on the table.
There are some students in the classroom.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be + 动词-ing + 介词短语

original.en: The ship is going under the bridge.

examples.en: The birds are flying over the trees.
The children are playing in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + is/are looking at + 名词

original.en: Sally is looking at a big ship.
original.zh: 莎莉正在看一艘大轮船。

examples.en: He is looking at the picture.
They are looking at the airplane.
